items.title: LinkedIn Hidden Code Secretly Searches Your Browser for Installed Extensions
items.description: Every time you open LinkedIn in a Chrome-based browser, hidden JavaScript silently scans your computer for installed software without your knowledge, without your consent, and without a single word in LinkedIn’s privacy policy.
